name: Pepsi Distribution
notes: v10.4.0: Major UI overhaul - Times New Roman font, modern glassmorphism design, animations, transparency effects. Added total packs/quantity display in sales/purchase forms. Implemented keyboard navigation (Enter/Arrow/Escape) for all form fields. All fields now fully editable (hand-to-hand, conditional, etc.). Added print functionality to all modules. Sales & purchases auto-update stock in products and stockbook. Auto calculations for packs/loose quantities. Modern responsive UI with smooth animations.
